evidence_boundary: This is a human curation/product-fit review, not native semantic execution evidence. Detailed skill-file review is required before material behavioral rewrites.

decision_definitions.KEEP: Distinct real-world value; preserve capability, with ordinary maintenance.
decision_definitions.REFINE: Valuable but scope, activation, language, evidence, policy or handoff needs improvement.
decision_definitions.MERGE: Material overlap means one clearer capability/contract should absorb it.
decision_definitions.RETIRE: Do not present as an active distributable capability; source/history may remain for audit.

delivery_definitions.CORE: Stable plugin core; should change rarely.
delivery_definitions.REGISTRY-ONLY: Discoverable through the live registry; not bundled in the stable plugin.
delivery_definitions.SOURCE-ONLY: Preserved in source/history but excluded from public capability discovery/distribution.
